Implant treatment, by the problem it solves

No standalone implant landing pages, and prices behind a download, is exactly why this page exists: pick your situation, see what the treatment involves, then ask for the price list.

Full-arch

All-On-X implants

For a full arch of missing or failing teeth: a fixed set of teeth supported by implants, planned as one complete restoration rather than tooth by tooth.

  • Full-mouth restoration planning
  • Bone graft & sinus lift where needed
  • General anaesthesia available
Metal-free

Zirconia implants

Zirconia (metal-free) implants for patients who want a metal-free option. Suitability depends on bone, bite and the tooth being replaced — confirmed at assessment, not promised online.

  • Metal-free implant option
  • Crowns and bridges to complete the restoration
  • Gum treatment and grafting where needed
Single tooth

Single implants

One missing tooth, replaced without cutting down the healthy teeth either side. The implant, abutment and crown are planned together so the result looks and chews like a natural tooth.

  • Single-tooth replacement
  • Root canal and emergency dentistry also available
  • EMS Airflow cleans, veneers and clear aligners

Also at the clinic: veneers, full-mouth restoration, clear aligners / Invisalign, emergency dentistry, root canal, EMS Airflow clean, general anaesthesia, bone graft & sinus lift, crowns / bridges, dentures, gum treatment / grafting.

Prices are not published — here is how to get them

The clinic publishes a downloadable price list rather than figures on its site, so this page quotes no figure. Request it below and the clinic can send the list for the treatment you are considering.

1. Choose your treatment in the booking form.

2. Send the enquiry — it opens in your own email app.

3. The clinic replies with the price list and next steps.

How implant treatment proceeds

Assessment

Examination, imaging and a check of bone, gums and bite — and whether implants suit you at all.

Plan & price list

A written plan for the implant, restoration and any grafting, with the downloadable price list to review at home.

Placement & healing

Implant placement, with general anaesthesia available, followed by healing time before the final teeth.

Final teeth & care

Crowns, bridge or full-arch teeth fitted, then ongoing cleans and checks to keep them healthy.

Questions patients actually ask

Why can’t I see a price on this page?

Because the clinic does not publish treatment figures on its site — it offers a downloadable price list. This page will not invent a figure; use the form to request the list.

Am I suitable for implants?

That depends on bone, gum health and general health. It is decided at assessment, not from a website form.

What if I need treatment urgently?

Emergency dentistry is listed among the clinic’s services. Call (03) 8820 1119 for urgent problems rather than waiting on an email reply.

What are your opening hours?

Monday to Friday, 8:30am–5:00pm. Saturday hours differ across the clinic’s own listings — confirmed at booking.
